items.label: diagnosis
items.evidence: it attempts to invoke `open_array` without passing a `mode` keyword argument, which errors.
items.rationale: Identifies the root cause in open_like: no mode passed to open_array, so it defaults to read-only behavior. The reference fix sets mode to "a" by default. It does not explicitly propose the fix, only the mechanism.
